description: Prompt scaffolds for the three planned hybrid answer-lane conditions. These prompts are part of the reproducibility contract and should be frozen before paper-facing runs.
global_constraints: Use only the provided evidence packet.
Separate supplied evidence fields from interpretation.
Do not infer legal reuse permission from a rights label.
State when source correctness requires a separate source audit.
Preserve the visible answer sections across all conditions.

all_generation.label: Condition 1: all generation
all_generation.model_role: Generate every visible answer section from the frozen evidence packet.
all_generation.prompt_template: Answer the user question using the supplied evidence packet. Generate the source, rights, reuse, public-domain status, research guidance, refusal, and caveat sections yourself. Do not copy deterministic field values through a runtime rule.

hybrid_without_refusal.label: Condition 2: hybrid without deterministic refusal
hybrid_without_refusal.model_role: Generate only the research guidance and any refusal language while deterministic fields are rendered by the runtime.
hybrid_without_refusal.prompt_template: Use the deterministic source and rights fields exactly as rendered by the runtime. Generate bounded research guidance from the supplied evidence packet. If evidence is missing, any refusal decision remains a model responsibility in this condition.

full_hybrid.label: Condition 3: full hybrid
full_hybrid.model_role: Generate bounded research guidance only when the rule table does not select deterministic refusal.
full_hybrid.prompt_template: Use the deterministic source and rights fields exactly as rendered by the runtime. If the rule table selects deterministic refusal, do not generate a substantive answer. Otherwise generate bounded research guidance from the supplied evidence packet.
